script:
printf '%s' '' > /tmp/mh.b64
base64 -d /tmp/mh.b64 > /tmp/mh.html
sudo cp /tmp/mh.html /var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html
sudo chmod 644 /var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html
ls -l /var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html
sha256sum /var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html
curl -s https://xinmo.work/memory.html | grep -c 'mg-mode'
rm -f /tmp/mh.b64
